Crockpot Hamburger Soup
By: Amy Jeanroy
Published: Monday, May 23, 2011 - 9:28am

Ingredients




1 pound ground beef
1 onion
1 stalk celery
1 package of dried onion soup mix
1 quart jar of canned tomatoes
3 cups water
2 cups assorted vegetables (use what is in the fridge)

Preparation

1 Brown the ground beef 2 Place in bottom of crockpot 3 Add remaining ingredients 4 Cook on low for 8 hours 5 Noodles can be added during last 20 minutes of cooking time

About


Here is a great soup to use the fresh vegetables that you are buying from the farmers markets and your garden.
